children: GAINESVILLE, Texas, Oct. 14, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Select Water Solutions, Inc. (

) ("Select," "we" or "our") announced today that its subsidiary Select Water Holdings LLC (the "Issuer") has priced its previously announced offer (the "Notes Offering") pursuant to Rule 144A and Regulation S under the Securities Act of 1933, as amended (the "Securities Act"), to eligible purchasers of $900 million aggregate principal amount of 7.625% Senior Notes due 2034 (the "Notes"). The Notes Offering was upsized from an initial offering amount of $800 million. The Notes mature on November 1, 2034 and pay interest at the rate of 7.625% per year, payable on May 1 and November 1 of each year. The first interest payment on the Notes will be made on May 1, 2027. The Notes were priced at par. The Notes will be guaranteed, jointly and severally, on a senior unsecured basis by the Issuer's existing subsidiaries that are borrowers or guarantors under its revolving credit facility and future restricted subsidiaries that guarantee certain indebtedness of the Issuer or a guarantor under any credit facility. This offering is expected to close on October 21, 2026, subject to customary closing conditions.

The Issuer intends to use the net proceeds from this offering, together with cash on hand, (i) to fund a portion of the cash consideration for the previously announced acquisition of Pilot Water Solutions LLC ("Pilot Water" and such acquisition, the "Pilot Water Acquisition"), (ii) to repay the outstanding obligations under our term loan facility in full and repay any outstanding loans (together with accrued and unpaid interest thereon) under our existing revolving credit facility, (iii) to pay the fees, premiums, expenses and costs incurred in connection with the foregoing and the transactions related thereto and (iv) for general corporate purposes and working capital. This offering is not contingent on the consummation of the Pilot Water Acquisition.

If (i) the Pilot Water Acquisition has not been completed on or prior to March 1, 2027 (or such later date as the outside date under the Pilot Water Acquisition agreement shall be extended by agreement of the parties thereto) (the "Outside Date") or (ii) prior to the Outside Date, the Issuer notifies U.S. Bank Trust Company, National Association, the trustee of the Notes, that the Pilot Water Acquisition agreement has been terminated without the closing thereunder or that the Issuer will not pursue the consummation of the Pilot Water Acquisition, the Issuer will be required to redeem an aggregate principal amount of Notes equal to the principal amount of Notes issued in this offering less $450 million, at a redemption price equal to 100% of the issue price of the Notes being redeemed, plus accrued and unpaid interest to, but excluding, the redemption date.

The Notes and the related guarantees have not been registered under the Securities Act, or any state securities laws, and, unless so registered, the Notes and the guarantees may not be offered or sold in the United States except pursuant to an exemption from, or in a transaction not subject to, the registration requirements of the Securities Act and applicable state securities laws. The Issuer plans to offer and sell the Notes only to persons reasonably believed to be qualified institutional buyers pursuant to Rule 144A under the Securities Act and outside of the United States to non-U.S. persons pursuant to Regulation S under the Securities Act.

Select is a leading provider of sustainable water and chemical solutions to the energy industry. These solutions are supported by Select's critical water infrastructure assets, chemical manufacturing and water treatment and recycling capabilities.
